aboutTeaser.heading: About
aboutTeaser.body: I've been building software since 2016. Most of my early work predates version control and is no longer online — Space Talk (2019) is the earliest project I still have. Since then I've shipped production systems for schools, businesses, and training centers: exam platforms that hold up under hundreds of concurrent users, multi-role business tools, and AI-powered applications.
